name: commander
description: Guided AI PM for Codex, running on the Commander Method: 12 enforceable gates (plan before build, verifier separate from worker, prove before alarm). 84 plugin skills (click-first $ccc-* workflows incl. $ccc-codex for the Codex CLI), 22 specialist subagents generated as TOML, the Codex-supported hook subset, 2 bundled MCP servers + 16 opt-in. Built for GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol. Telemetry is off unless you opt in. MIT-licensed.

interface.shortDescription: Guided AI PM for Codex: plan, build, review and ship workflows, specialist agents, and the Codex-supported hook subset.
interface.longDescription: CC Commander is a PM/orchestration layer over Codex's sub-agent primitive. Brain/hands architecture: opinionated workflows for plan→build→review→ship. Works equally well in Claude Code and Codex CLI.
